agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in boltons/strutils.py MultiReplace.__init__: changed erroneous re.escape(vals[1]) to re.escape(vals[0]) when building the combined regex pattern for non-regex substitutions. This was causing the compiled pattern to search for replacement text instead of original text, breaking MultiReplace/multi_replace functionality. Verified fix works correctly via manual tests and the module's doctests (all 79 pass).
